cta: Save this if you brief AI inside a media buying workflow

design_dials_applied.notes: Variance 7 comes from four structurally different zones on one page (rail, three-lane flow, node band, collapse strip) rather than a repeated card template. Motion 6 is parallel zone choreography on one clock, not a scene-by-scene video. Density 7 sits inside the archetype range 4-8 and is earned through hierarchy: one 68px hero, one 400px centre anchor, six 20px node labels.

execution_bridge.final-output: Right lane: three decision chips where the buyer selects one, then the collapse strip resolving to SHORTER TIME-TO-DECISION.
execution_bridge.raw-input: Left lane: six named signal chips carrying a platform token and a metric direction.
execution_bridge.stages: Centre lane: the AI-assisted interpretation panel where signals group into three example insights, then the six-decision node band beneath it.

ai-assistant.job: groups signals and offers the insight card

selected_concept.aha_mechanic: Manual stages collapse into signal, interpretation, decision
selected_concept.copy_hook: AI doesn't buy the media. It shortens the time between signal and decision.
selected_concept.name: The Latency Gap
selected_concept.visual_hook: A signal-to-decision rail whose gap physically shortens on the loop

story_house_rationale: Signal Desk is the only house with a white ground and an encoding set of support accents. The brief needs colour to carry meaning (signal class, stage, decision state), which a single-accent house cannot express without decorative recolouring.

structural_fingerprint.card_grammar: mixed-span: narrow signal chips, one large centre panel, small decision chips, numbered node band
structural_fingerprint.motion_grammar: connector draw with travelling signal tokens plus node state pulse
structural_fingerprint.visual_anchor: the centre interpretation panel carrying both mascots
structural_fingerprint.zone_topology: banded flow with a lateral three-lane centre and a closed return loop

takeaway: AI's real advantage in media buying is a shorter distance between signal and decision, and the buyer still owns the decision
topic: How AI actually helps a modern media buyer
